case_name: Dinesh S/O Ram Babu B/C Chhipa v. State Of Rajasthan

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Dinesh S/o Ram Babu B/c Chhipa, husband
parties.respondent_defendant: State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp., and Sunita @ Deepika D/o Ram Kishore B/c Chhipi, wife

facts_of_case: Petitioner's wife filed a complaint under Section 498A, 341 & 323 IPC. Petitioner seeks quashing of proceedings.

legal_principles.principle: Parties can agree to withdraw pending cases and put in appearance as needed.
legal_principles.held: One of the conditions of settlement was that parties have agreed to withdraw all the pending cases qua each other criminal or civil. In case appearance of either party is necessary before any court of law; they have agreed to put in appearance as and when called upon to do so.

legal_principles.principle: Alimony can be paid as a one-time settlement in divorce proceedings.
legal_principles.held: The appellant has agreed to pay as onetime alimony of Rs. 5,00,000/- (Rupees Five Lac Only), to the non-appellant wife.

outcome.final_order: Proceedings quashed; parties agreed to withdraw all pending cases and pay alimony.
